This banner lasts 30 seconds on the map. |ability3_cooldown = 30 }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|I hope whatever that thing was comes through!|audio = FrostWave38-4.ogg|[[Professor V]] on Wave 33 ([[Frost Mode|Frost]])}} }} == Description == The '''Frost Champion''' is a major mini boss that appears in [[Frost Mode]] on Wave 33. It has a high amount of health and slightly slow speed. The '''Frost Champion''' has three ability, though it cannot use one until 10 seconds have passed since spawning. There is also an attack cooldown of 5 set for all of its abilities. These abilities are: #''Summon'', which makes the '''Frost Champion''' summon five enemies with a 0.75 delay between each. There is a 60% chance for it to be a [[Frost Invader]] and a 40% chance for it to be the [[Unstable Ice]]. #''Spear Thrust'', where it winds up its spear and thrusts it at a tower or unit in its range of 25. This will stun towers hit in its hitbox that has a length of 20 for 4 seconds and damage units by 1,000 damage. Due to the spear actually not reaching to the end of its ability range, in rare circumstances the '''Frost Champion''' will target towers that it cannot reach with its spear, making it do absolutely nothing. #''Frozen Banner'', which has the '''Frost Champion''' grab a heavy grey banner from its back and throw it at a tower or, despite it doing nothing to them, unit in its range of 30. This creates a debuff range of 15 around the banner which for 30 seconds will apply a 10% [[Firerate Debuff]] to towers. ==Appearance== The '''Frost Champion''' has blue skin and a green head. It wears light blue and grey pants, chestplate, shoulder-pads, wrist-pads, knee-pads, shoes and helmet. On its helmet, it has two blue horns, with the left one being longer. Around its neck it has blue fur. It also wears a grey belt with a blue crystal. It wields a long grey and blue spear. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers such as [[Accelerator]], [[Juggernaut]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] and [[Gatling Gun]] are recommended due to its high health. **Towers capable of buffing firerate or damage such as [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Medic]] are useful in maximizing DPS when the '''Frost Champion''' reduces it with its ''Frozen Banner'' ability. ***Do note however that the [[Medic]] cannot protect towers from the ''Frozen Banner'' ability, as its shield does not prevent debuffs. *Its ''Summon'' ability summons in the [[Frost Invader]], which is a [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy and the [[Unstable Ice]], which is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, meaning appropriate lead detection and hidden detection towers are needed. **However, by this stage of the game, these should not be particularly difficult to deal with. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FrostModeThumbnail.png|'''Frost Champion''' on the game thumbnail.
